verdicts.reason: A flips the hierarchy: the italic subline 'food & drinks' is about three times the size of the 'Order online' headline. Both candidates crop the packaging photo out, leaving only an orange sliver at the bottom-right edge, and both push the shortened divider rules out to the top and bottom edges. B keeps the headline larger than the subline, but the two are scattered across a mostly empty grey column with no imagery, so it fails on fidelity and on use of space.
